description: Every way an append-only hash chain can be attacked, and the verdict the harness must return. ChangeLedgerTamperTest injects each one.

vectors.attack: Modify a field in an event in the middle of the chain
Insert a fabricated event between two real ones
Delete an event from the middle

vectors.expected: TAMPERED at the first reordered index

vectors.attack: Truncate the tail and rewrite the head pointer
vectors.expected: TAMPERED: head does not match the recomputed chain

vectors.attack: Append after the ledger is sealed
vectors.expected: Refused; reopening requires an explicit reopen with a reason

vectors.attack: Recompute the whole chain after editing an event
vectors.expected: Head no longer matches the recorded seal hash

vectors.attack: Replace the head pointer file alone
vectors.expected: TAMPERED: recomputed chain disagrees with the pointer
